allusions.quote: whom God raised from the dead, having loosed the pains of Hades. “In whom, though now ye see Him not, ye believe, and believing, rejoice with joy unspeakable and full of glory;
Judge not, that ye be not judged; forgive, and it shall be forgiven unto you; be merciful, that ye may obtain mercy; with what measure ye mete, it shall be measured to you again;
